stem: Even though these puppies have the same parents, they do not all look alike because —

options.label: A
options.text: they were produced by asexual cloning

options.label: B
options.text: some of the puppies have genetic material from only one of the parents

options.label: C
options.text: each puppy has a different combination of genetic material as a result of sexual reproduction

options.label: D
options.text: all the puppies developed from the same fertilized egg

visual_elements: A photograph of a litter of six-week-old bulldog puppies shows that the puppies are not identical.
